resources.string: When enabled, DiPlay takes over USB, VPN, audio, microphone and HUD for the Camry A-navigation head unit. Automatic detection matches the head-unit model; choose Force on when detection misses, or Off on other vehicles. Reconnect CarPlay after changing this setting.
Adaptation off — connects as a standard head unit
Auto-detection: Camry A-navigation head unit detected; adaptation enabled
Auto-detection: not a Camry A-navigation head unit; adaptation disabled
